comment: Corpus slug -> MCP Registry id. Built 2026-10-18 via registry search API (WebFetch). null = not found in registry or no official entry. Community entries noted where relevant.

hostinger.note: official; registry version line 0.1.x-1.x is disjoint from npm 2.x (two artifacts)

currents.note: pipeworx is the Currents company; also dev.currents/mcp

figma.note: community server we track; the official is com.figma.mcp/mcp (different namespace, not our corpus)

sentry.note: getsentry org; our npm package is @sentry/mcp-server - may be a different artifact

supabase.note: no clear official entry; io.github.mcp-dir/supabase-mcp is community; npm @supabase/mcp-server-supabase may not be registered

notion.note: no official @notionhq entry; community alternatives exist

heroku.note: no official entry; io.github.dsouzaAnush/heroku-code-mcp is community

netlify.note: all entries are app.netlify.* format, not io.github.*

bybit.note: not found; trading-mcp npm package may not be registered

hubspot.note: no official HubSpot entry; community alternatives exist

shopify.note: no official @shopify/dev-mcp entry; community shopify MCP servers exist
